gen-dafont-arkhip-fs-asap: Modern and geometric, Arkhip spaces its wire-thin letters far apart, each c gaping like a bent paperclip, while Asap stands by below. Its lowercase nearly matches the capitals, so text flows steadily.
gen-dafont-arkhip-fs-merriweather-sans: Floaty, spaced-out letters with a pencil-line stroke: that's Arkhip up top. Merriweather Sans is the sturdy half, its tall lowercase making every word look large and solid.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-bhutuka-expanded-on: Arkhip floats, wire-light and wide apart. BhuTuka Expanded One brings curvy, literary weight beneath it, with joins as thick as the stems, so a classic serif paragraph slows to a leisurely walk.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-stint-ultra-expande: Stint Ultra Expanded is a text serif with traditional authority, every character floating apart and its counters opening outward, much like Arkhip's. Both feel strung from pipe cleaner.
gen-dafont-arkhip-switzer: Switzer reads as approachable and Swiss, with tubular, wire-like letters whose c tips never creep toward touching, under Arkhip's spaced-out display heading. Text moves along with a tall waist line and unhurried ease.
gen-dafont-azonix-bitter: Bitter reads dependable and grounded, with a very large lowercase eye and an s you can see straight through. Its slab-serif sturdiness against Azonix's tube-like, constant-width commanding strokes is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary and dignified, with a tall middle band. Azonix is best at commanding attention with its wide-mouthed, crisp capitals, while the classic serif below is best at lettering that is gentle on the eye.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-glegoo: Glegoo is a refined, editorial classic serif. Its big counters and wide, unclosed curves keep a long paragraph flowing, in contrast to Azonix's marker-like constant stroke above.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-hanuman: Traditional and refined, Hanuman sits under Azonix's commanding tube-line capitals. Its high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on the s make a long stretch of serif text read with unhurried grace.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-kadwa: Azonix leads with a constant, marker-like stroke and authority. Kadwa's open-ended curves and larger-than-usual x-height give the serif beneath it a classic, editorial warmth, which is the pair's strongest single quality.
